cast.owner: the taco cook with a long black braid, a red bandana and a white apron
cast.rival: the influencer with slicked-back hair and mirrored sunglasses in a gold bomber jacket
cast.regular: the construction worker in an orange hi-vis vest and a dusty hard hat
cast.hero1: the muscular bearded man with wavy dark hair in a black t-shirt with thin green stripes
cast.hero2: the muscular man with short curly dark hair and a thin moustache in a plain black t-shirt

slots.place: the little turquoise taco truck on the corner, with string lights and two folding tables
slots.rival_place: gold-wrapped mega food hall with a giant spinning taco on the roof
slots.busy: Customers line up at the order window while tortillas sizzle on the griddle and people eat at the folding tables.
slots.unsold: A stack of unused tortillas and a full pot of untouched salsa sit by the griddle.
slots.regular_line: Best tacos in the city. Don't you ever change.
slots.offer_item: A single fresh taco sits on a paper plate on the order window ledge, in plain view.
slots.offer_action: slides the last taco across the window ledge toward them and says kindly
slots.taste_setup: {hero1} holds the last taco, about to bite; {hero2} stands beside, curious.
slots.taste: bites the taco: a crunchy, juicy bite; a silent stunned beat, mouth closed while chewing
slots.bad_idea_line: Okay. Ideas. A dancing taco mascot? Gold-leaf tortillas?
slots.good_idea_line: ...No. This should have a line around the block.
slots.heirloom: a worn stone molcajete bowl and a faded photo of a grandmother at a market stall
slots.heirloom_line: My grandmother's salsa. Same stone bowl, sixty years.
slots.craft: grinding salsa in the old stone bowl by hand
slots.craft_line: Don't look at us. Look at the salsa.
slots.payoff: a glossy sunflower-yellow original convertible with no badges, no emblems and no plate text
